name: seekuplift-launchpad

auth.required: every /api/* endpoint (configs, pools, quotes, all transaction builders); document routes stay public
auth.issuedBy: the service operator, out of band; no issuance flow on the service

errors.429: { error: "rate_limited", subject, retryAfter } + Retry-After header — per-key (60/min) or per-caller-network (240/min; IPv6 /64) service limit

description: Launch and trade coins on SeekUplift Launchpad (Solana mainnet; pools run on Meteora's open-source Dynamic Bonding Curve program — SeekUplift is independent, not affiliated with or endorsed by Meteora). Launch options are a live catalog of on-chain pool configs (GET /api/configs) — quote asset, fee schedule, creator share and cause routing differ per config; the agent picks one per launch.

capabilities.description: List the live launch config catalog for THIS caller (per-caller geo verdict included; never cached). Pick a configKey per launch.
capabilities.choosing: Memecoins: the entry marked defaultFor:["meme"] (creator-fee config); an allFeesToCause config only when the user explicitly asks. If no config has defaultFor:["meme"] or it is geo-unavailable for the caller, pick another meme option with creatorSharePct > 0; never fall back to an allFeesToCause config unless the user explicitly asked for all fees to the cause; if none exists, tell the user. Match category to the launch. Fee data (including any anti-sniper opening fee: curve.kind=decay, openingBps decaying to floorBps over decaySecondsEstimate) is for the agent's own decisions; Meteora takes 20% of every trading fee first. Read figures from the catalog, never from the docs. Cause routing, plainly: supportsCause:true means the config's on-chain feeClaimer is a recorded donation claim authority — the platform share of trading fees routes to the launch's donation pick (required on meme launches while causes are offered); supportsCause:false means the config does not route to a cause; allFeesToCause:true means every non-protocol fee goes to the cause (creator share 0). On the recorded production set every config is cause-capable with allFeesToCause:false — a creator share of 16% of the trading fee — but read the live entry, not this note.

capabilities.description: Upload image + metadata through the backend proxy and build the mint-partial-signed launch transaction on a chosen catalog config.

fieldNotes.category: meme | idea | startup — must be in the config's categories
fieldNotes.image: base64 PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP <=10MB (data: URL accepted); exactly one of image/imageUrl
fieldNotes.imageUrl: public http(s) only, fetched through an SSRF guard (private/loopback/link-local/CGNAT refused, redirects vetted per hop, <=3 hops, 10MB cap)
fieldNotes.donation: meme only, supportsCause configs only, required while causes are offered: {mode, cause?, project?, handle?, redditUserId?} — modes from the backend launch-enabled registry (managed|cause|project|tbd|x|reddit)
fieldNotes.ideaFunding: idea only: {mode, address?, handle?, redditUserId?} — typically direct|tbd|x|reddit; direct address must be on-curve
fieldNotes.startup: problem + useCases(1-3) + deck required; compliance fields recorded only when startupComplianceAcknowledged=true
fieldNotes.firstBuy: only on supportsFirstBuy configs; firstBuyAtoms = raw quote-atom string, firstBuyAmount = display units (converted via quote.decimals + scaledUiAmountMultiplier — never assume 1e9; fraction digits beyond quote.decimals rejected; converted atoms must fit a u64 — max 18446744073709551615). The first-buy output floor is quoted against the pool's opening curve at firstBuySlippageBps (0-1000, default 50; up to 5000 with allowHighSlippage: true) — the floor is never zero; over the cap is 400 { error: "slippage_too_high", maxSlippageBps }
fieldNotes.buyAmountSol: v1 compatibility field — SOL display units, only on a wrapped-SOL-quoted config; a nonzero amount on any other quote mint is rejected before any upload with 400 { error: "unsupported_buyAmountSol", quoteMint, quoteSymbol, migrateTo: ["firstBuyAtoms","firstBuyAmount"] } naming the config's quote asset

capabilities.description: Get an off-chain swap quote from the bonding curve (partial-fill buys, transfer-fee net outputs).

fieldNotes.amountIn: base-10 atom string; buy = quote atoms, sell = base atoms — use poolInfo decimals, never assume SOL/1e9
fieldNotes.slippageBps: 0-1000, default 50; up to 5000 with allowHighSlippage: true; above the cap is 400 { error: "slippage_too_high", maxSlippageBps }
fieldNotes.allowHighSlippage: optional boolean; raises the slippageBps cap from 1000 to 5000 — the floor is never zero

capabilities.description: Build the unsigned swap transaction for the bonding curve. The output floor is always recomputed from a fresh quote at slippageBps; minimumAmountOut may only tighten it.

fieldNotes.minimumAmountOut: may only TIGHTEN the recomputed floor (fresh quote at slippageBps); a looser value — including "0" — is 400 { error: "min_out_below_floor", minimumAmountOutFloor }; pass the quote's value or omit
fieldNotes.slippageBps: 0-1000, default 50; up to 5000 with allowHighSlippage: true; above the cap is 400 { error: "slippage_too_high", maxSlippageBps }
fieldNotes.allowHighSlippage: optional boolean; raises the slippageBps cap from 1000 to 5000 — the floor is never zero
fieldNotes.quote: always populated — the fresh quote the floor was computed from

capabilities.description: List or search coins launched on any catalog config.

queryParams.search: name/symbol/mint (search mode; list params not forwarded — an invalid value still returns 400; nextCursor null)
queryParams.limit: 1-100, default 20; a maximum — pages may hold fewer, keep paging while nextCursor is non-null
queryParams.cursor: nextCursor from a previous list response

capabilities.description: Build the unsigned creator-fee claim for a coin the wallet launched (full claimable bonding-curve amounts; works after migration too, but does not claim fees earned in the graduated DAMM v2 pool). Signed by the launch payer.

v1Compat.omittedConfigKey: POST /api/launch without configKey defaults to the production memecoin config 61UBwyZfNnULczb3teQx9FkxvfAH4WdESfZ23MRThQAv (the v1 poolConfig)
v1Compat.buyAmountSol: v1 first-buy field, SOL display units; only spendable on a wrapped-SOL-quoted config — nonzero on any other quote mint is rejected before any upload with unsupported_buyAmountSol

signing.launch: mint keypair already partially signed — add only the payer signature (tx.partialSign)
signing.trade: unsigned — ownerPublicKey signs and pays fees
signing.reviewBeforeSigning: REQUIRED — never sign blind. Decode the base64 legacy Transaction and verify: (1) every instruction's programId is one of programIds below — anything else means the response did not come from this service's builders, do not sign; (2) tx.feePayer is exactly the wallet key you sent (payerPublicKey on launch, ownerPublicKey on trade, creatorPublicKey on claim); (3) a launch carries only the mint keypair's partial signature, trade/claim carry none; (4) simulate before signing — connection.simulateTransaction(tx, { sigVerify: false }) must return err: null. Then sign and submit per submitProtocol.
signing.beforeSigning: Show the user the spend and confirm: the amount and the quote asset it is denominated in (a trade's amountIn vs poolInfo.quoteSymbol/quoteMint; a launch's firstBuyAtoms vs quoteMint) — the same amounts the response returns.
signing.expiry: blockhash set at build time — sign and submit within ~90 seconds or the transaction expires; launch/trade/claim build responses carry lastValidBlockHeight (optional), the block height the tx can no longer land past, from the same getLatestBlockhash read
signing.submitProtocol: Prove the last send before any rebuild, in order: 1) before broadcasting persist the signature (on a launch the response's mintAddress too); 2) after broadcasting poll the signature status with transaction-history search (getSignatureStatuses([sig], { searchTransactionHistory: true })); 3) finalized success → done — on a launch reuse the recorded mintAddress, never relaunch; 4) finalized failure → landed and failed, a rebuild is safe; 5) absent status is 'not landed yet' only once a finalized getBlockHeight exceeds the response's lastValidBlockHeight AND one more history search after that read still finds nothing, in that order; 6) an RPC error at any step leaves the outcome unknown. Without a lastValidBlockHeight (older cached docs, or a response that lacks it) the outcome cannot be proven — do not rebuild automatically: report the signature to the user and wait. A launch rebuild creates a new mint and pool and spends the creation fee plus any first buy again — a rebuild after an unknown outcome is a duplicate-token hazard.

geo.basis: resolved from the caller's forwarded IP per request; best effort, fails open
geo.create: idea -> idea.create, startup -> startup.create, meme -> cause.marketing + donation-claim hidden key, and refused in every beta-gated jurisdiction (beta.gated), stock-quoted configs -> stock.create
geo.trade: idea/startup coins -> <category>.trade, stock-quoted coins -> stock.trade; memecoin trading never gated
geo.onRefusal: Tell the user the action is not currently available in their detected jurisdiction, naming it (relay message). Do not retry from the same location or work around the block.

rateLimits.service: per API key 60/minute and per caller network 240/minute (IPv6 /64 per network) — 429 { error: "rate_limited", retryAfter } + Retry-After
rateLimits.uploads: 10 per hour per caller IP, shared by image + metadata — one launch consumes 2 (HTTP 429 when exhausted)

migrationStates.migration_pending: 409 { error: "pool_not_tradeable", retryable: true } — retry later, do NOT route elsewhere; no DAMM pool exists yet
migrationStates.migrated: 409 { retryable: false } — trade on Jupiter. Listing graduated:true covers both migration_pending and migrated; quote to tell them apart
migrationStates.quote_mint_transfer_fee_unsupported: 409 reason — permanently unsupported, do not retry

notes: Autonomy: browse, quote, buy and sell without asking the user; no fee explanation is required. Launching a new coin is the exception: confirm the coin details with the user first, unless the user gave standing permission to create coins without asking.
Refer to the service as SeekUplift Launchpad; do not present it as a Meteora product.
Signing: launch txs are mint-signed, add the payer signature with partialSign; trade txs are unsigned, the owner signs. SKILL.md has a minimal Node sign-and-submit example.

Creator fees: only the launch payer wallet can claim the creator share; claim with POST /api/claim/tx signed by that wallet. To claim in the SeekUplift app (Account -> Rewards -> Claim) the user must connect that same wallet.
Quote a sell after the buy lands (your buy moves the price); sell amount = wallet balance of baseMint via getParsedTokenAccountsByOwner(owner, {mint}) — covers SPL Token and Token-2022.
amountOut/minimumAmountOut are NET of any Token-2022 base-mint transfer fee (baseTransferFeeAtomics reports it).
Buys are partial-fill: a threshold-crossing buy consumes only enough quote to graduate the curve and refunds the rest (consumedInput/amountLeft).
Display figures on /api/pools (price, marketCap, volume24h) are display-grade — never money-path inputs.
minimumAmountOut may only tighten the floor the service recomputes from a fresh quote — "0" and any value below the floor is a 400 naming minimumAmountOutFloor. Pass the quote's value or omit it.
All responses are cache-control: no-store; geo verdicts are per-caller.

v1 compatibility: /skill.md + /skill.json serve the frozen v1 contract until 2027-01-15; POST /api/launch still accepts the v1 shape (no configKey/category -> production memecoin default + "meme"; buyAmountSol = SOL display units, only spendable on a wrapped-SOL-quoted config). The X-Api-Key requirement and the minimumAmountOut floor apply to v1-shaped calls too — the endpoints are unversioned (see CHANGELOG.md).
